mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, product_id, order_id, content, score, status, create_time FROM comment WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.order_id, c.content, c.score, c.status, c.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.product_id = #{productId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.order_id, c.content, c.score, c.status, c.create_time, u.nickname, p.name AS product_name FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id
